name: Kuzaku
source:
Also known as "Two-Sword"/"Two-Gun", due to his skillfulness with a set of twin-blades (the Lloigor & Zhar) and twin handguns (Cthugha & Ithaqua). This handsome young man with long, braided hair possesses the aura of a knight. He chases after a girl in red and pilots the Deus Machina Demonbane Two-Sword. [spoiler]His full name is Kuzaku Daijūji, the son of two Elder Gods from another dimension. After he was born, he was left in the care of [url=/c934]Ruri Hadou[/url] in the "original world" the visual novel took place in. He has a grudge towards his father for "throwing him away".[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Demonbane_characters#Characters_that_appear_in_other_media]Wikipedia[/url].]

"Although i live by the way of magic, however my heart (soul) is dedicated to the chivalry (sword). ---Devil, must be smited."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.demonbane.com/special/]Demonbane Official Site[/url]]
